parsed.why: No trans-specific offence, no facilities ban, no documented police targeting of trans people or trans violence. But hostile official rhetoric, rising right-wing hostility, Pride organisers fined, and no gender-identity protection or working recourse.

Tier-1 state exposures: passport markers refused/confiscated, X eliminated, entry refusal and lifetime-fraud risk, criminal facility bans with a documented arrest, birth-sex custody and care denial, plus 'pro-transgender' counterterror framing.

No criminalisation, no facilities rule, marriage and adoption open, no documented hostility or organised opponents, dated accounts of comfortable coexistence. Gaps are resident-facing only: no gender-marker procedure or GI anti-discrimination ground.

Colonial sodomy felonies (14/7/5 years) capture trans women read as male, no GI protection or recognition. But enforcement documented absent since 2013, no government abuses, no facilities ban, and a recognised third-gender tradition.

State-directed tier-2 pattern: presentation-based arrests and 2023 cross-dressing conviction, police sexual coercion, criminalised advocacy, impunity, no protections, abusive custody and care denial, 3-year sodomy statute.
